resources.name: Lennard-Jones potential parameters for Ar-Ar, Ar-Xe, Xe-Xe

access.notes: Ar-Ar: σ=0.3405 nm, ε=120 K, mass=6.63382e-26 kg; Ar-Xe: σ=3.65, ε=1.48 (reduced units); Xe-Xe: σ=4.10, ε=1.853 (reduced). Source: Scharf et al., J. Chem. Phys. 88, 4273 (1988). Parameter values are also given in the paper's text (References 8, 9). No separate download required.

resources.notes: These are the force-field constants needed for the simulations. They are public and can be directly coded.
